scale.font-sans: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, "Apple Color Emoji", Arial, sans-serif, "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"
scale.font-sans-zh: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", Helvetica, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Apple Color Emoji", Arial, sans-serif, "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"
scale.font-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", "JetBrains Mono", Menlo, Courier, monospace
scale.font-code: SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "PT Mono", "Liberation Mono", Courier, monospace

lightHighContrast.chrome-button-background: rgb(from rgba(42, 28, 0, 0.07) r g b / calc(alpha * (1 + 0.5 * 3)))

darkHighContrast.chrome-button-background: rgb(from rgba(255, 255, 243, 0.082) r g b / calc(alpha * (1 + 0.5 * 3)))
